description: Download the video/audio at any URL (YouTube, TikTok, X, and 1000+ sites) to hosted storage and get back a direct download link. Importly runs yt-dlp, rotating residential proxies, and ffmpeg server-side — no local tooling needed. Async: returns a jobId immediately; poll check_import for the result. Optionally also produce a transcript in the same job with includeTranscript.

includeTranscript.description: Also transcribe the audio in the same job

transcriptLanguage.description: ISO language hint for the transcript, e.g. "en"

name: import_media
